i/update-email.note: メールは SMTP ではなく Cloudflare Email Service（EMAIL バインディング）で mk-jobs の sendEmail ジョブから送信（Workers から SMTP 不可）。smtp* 設定は未使用
i/update-email.noteEn: Mail is sent from the mk-jobs sendEmail job via Cloudflare Email Service (the EMAIL binding), not SMTP (SMTP is not possible from Workers). smtp* settings are unused

admin/send-email.note: 送信は Cloudflare Email Service（upstream 同様に同期送信、失敗時 500）。smtp* 設定は未使用
admin/send-email.noteEn: Sending uses Cloudflare Email Service (synchronous send, the same as upstream; 500 on failure). smtp* settings are unused

request-reset-password.note: メールは Cloudflare Email Service で mk-jobs 経由の非同期送信（Workers から SMTP 不可）
request-reset-password.noteEn: Mail is sent asynchronously via mk-jobs using Cloudflare Email Service (SMTP is not possible from Workers)

email-address/available.note: 能動検証は verifymail / truemail API、どちらも未設定なら deep-email-validator 相当（同梱の使い捨てドメイン一覧と、DNS over HTTPS（cloudflare-dns.com）での MX 確認）
email-address/available.noteEn: Active validation uses the verifymail / truemail API; if neither is configured, it is equivalent to deep-email-validator (the bundled disposable-domain list, and an MX check via DNS over HTTPS (cloudflare-dns.com))

signup.note: 特殊ルート（endpoint-list 外）。EMAIL バインディングが無いと emailRequiredForSignup を無視（メールを送れないため）。初期セットアップ前（rootUserId が null）は SETUP_REQUIRED で拒否し、最初の登録者を root にしない
signup.noteEn: Special route (outside endpoint-list). Without the EMAIL binding, emailRequiredForSignup is ignored (because mail cannot be sent). Before initial setup (rootUserId is null) it is rejected with SETUP_REQUIRED, and the first registrant is not made root
signup.summary: 初期セットアップ前は拒否

signup-pending.note: 特殊ルート（endpoint-list 外）。初期セットアップ前（rootUserId が null）は SETUP_REQUIRED で拒否
signup-pending.noteEn: Special route (outside endpoint-list). Before initial setup (rootUserId is null) it is rejected with SETUP_REQUIRED
signup-pending.summary: 初期セットアップ前は拒否
